To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the semi-IPNs with different ratios of linear copolymeric chains were successfully prepared and the addition of linear copolymers increased the fracture strain, while the compressibility modulus decreased.
a series of semi-IPN p(NIPAM–co–IAM)/pNIPAm hydrogels were successfully synthesized and their properties were investigated.

the novel pH and thermo dual responsive semi-IPN (p(NIPAM-co-IA)/pNIPAm) hydrogels with a porous structure were synthesized successfully and could be controlled and regulated by the addition of linear copolymers in the semi- IPN hydrogel network.

the synthesis of pH- and thermo-responsive hydrogels based on N-isoproplyacrylamide with itaconamic acid.
the synthesis of a series of semi-inter-penetration polymer network (semi IPN) hydrogela) by introducing a linear copolymer into a N-isoproplyacrylamide(NIPAM) solution.
the synthesis of novel semi-IPN p(NIPAM-Co-IAM)/p(NIPAM) hydrogels with dual-responsive properties.

the addition of the linear copolymers in the semi- IPN structure increased the fracture strain and decreased the compressive modulus of the semi-IPNs.
the novel semi-IPN p(NIPAM-Co-IAM)/p(NIPAM) hydrogels have been successfully synthesized by free radical polymerizations.
a series of semi-IPN p(NIPAMco-IAM)/p(NIPAM) hydrogels with a dual-responsive behavior were successfully synthesized and characterized.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have successfully synthesized the novel pH and thermo dual responsive semi-IPN based on N-isoproplyacrylamide.
a series of pH-thermo responsive semi-IPN p(NIPAMco-IAM)/p(NIPAM) hydrogels with different pore sizes were synthesized successfully by free radical copolymerization.
the novel pH and thermo dual responsive semi-IPN p(NIPAM-Co-IAM)/p-NIPAM hydrogels were successfully synthesized by free radical polymerisation.
The main takeaway from our work is that

a series of pH-thermo responsive hydrogels with a semi-IPN network were synthesized by introducing the linear copolymeric chain into the hydrogel matrix, and the hydrogels showed pH-thermo sensitive properties.
the addition of the linear copolymers to the semi-IPNs increased the pore sizes and decreased the compressive modulus of the hydrogals.
the semi-IPNs are an effective way to control the swelling properties of hydrogels.
